A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

, in the supersymmetric models with the Z ′ resonance, the dileptons and the four leptons at the Z ′ mass can be complementary to each other in searching for the Z ′ resonance and the supersymmetric particles.

, in supersymmetric theories where the Z ′ boson is the lightest neutral gauge boson, the Z ′ bosons decay to dilepton and four lepton final states with a branching fraction of order one, while the Z ′ -mediated four lepton resonance can be a promising signal for the supersymmetry search at the LHC.

, if a new Z ′ resonance is discovered at the LHC with the mass in the 1-2 TeV range, the supersymmetric framework would be a very natural explanation, and the supersymmetry searches at the LHC should focus on the four leptons resonance at the Z'pole, in addition to the dileptons resonance at the same pole.

the four leptons signal is a well-matched signal to the dilepton signal, and the four leptons signal can be used as a supersymmetries search scheme even in early stage of the experiment.
